blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: performance model — Simplification estimating resource use.
stall — Delay in progress through stages.

blocks.title: Define the heuristic
blocks.text: A heuristic quickly estimates how promising a choice is; it is not automatically an exact solution.

blocks.title: Model the trade-off
blocks.text: Separate local edge cost, accumulated cost and estimated remaining cost before choosing a path.

blocks.title: Pipeline and performance models
blocks.text: A pipeline can overlap independent stages, increasing throughput, but dependencies and resource constraints may cause stalls.

blocks.title: Worked example · Predict first
blocks.text: Calculate complete route costs, rather than deciding only from the first edge.
